Vault 2120

By: Stenette Grosskopf | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Never before has a time capsule project on this scale been undertaken...

Unique Selling Point:
Vault 2120 South Africa is an international social/historical/scientific experiment to create a secure, airtight and watertight underground vault in South Africa where individuals, companies and institutions will be able to securely deposit artefacts, documents, art works, information, music, technologies, personal/family items and the like in individual containers also known as time capsules. Carte Blanche will have an exclusive look at how the vault will be built, what will be put inside and how this bit of history will be safe-guarded for generations to come.

Summary:
The world is set to change dramatically over the next 100 years. Futurists predict that our world will be unrecognisable by the year 2100. With that in mind Eugene Botha has set out to create the Vault 2120 project. The Vault will be built and sealed in 2019 -- a airtight, watertight concrete vault will be buried underground at a location in Maropeng - the cradle of humankind. Eugene has a representation of what the vault will look like. It will consist of two chambers. One chamber will be the actual vault with "treasures" from our world today -- including never-seen-before works of art and literature, scientific and historic contributions, as well as contributions from individuals and societies. The other chamber will house a yearly time capsule added to the cache. The time capsule will contain some artefacts from the specific year. Together with Eugene and Piet Muller, the presenter will be involved in packing/preparing the time capsule for 2018. So in effect every year something will be added to the vault. A Trust has been established to oversee the process until 2120 when the Vault will be opened.

Further information:
Dion & Bronwyn are trends analysts who can speak to the radical changes awaiting us in the future. Can deliver comment on the Vault and why it is a good idea. Dr Piet Muller is a philosopher and in favour of the idead of a Vault. He is also convinced that the world as we know it is about to change radically. He is one of the people overseeing the 2018 time capsule and will speak to the value of the 15 items added to this year's time capsule.


Preliminary Structure of the Story:

Opening statement
“We are doing something that has never been done before on this scale in the history of the world, and it is called the Vault 2120 Time Capsule Initiative.”

LINK at Maropeng: This is the cradle of humankind, but this spot will have a greater significance for generations to come...

What exactly is Vault 2120? (Eugene, show model and animation)
Social, cultural, scientific and historical experiment, Vault underground, Individual time capsules for 101 years, Sealed in 2019


Why are you doing this? (Eugene)
Reason 1: “I have always been fascinated by Time Capsules. They are Time capsules are mesmerizing, mysterious, enigmatic, even romantic. They tell stories of another time, they hold secrets, they bring the past to life.”

Reason 2: The world as we know it, is set to change fundamentally and rapidly


How will the world change? (Chang, Williams & Muller)
Examples Dion Chang & Bronwyn Williams of new and exponential technologies
Examples by Piet Muller of the Future
But there are other more negative possibilities:
Climate change
Sun storm -- something like the Carrington event
Meteorite hitting earth


What will you put inside the Vault and Time Capsules?
General overview of participants and special time capsules (Eugene)
Specific Time Capsules (Dion & Bronwyn on Capsule with predictions)


But is a vault underground not boring?
It is, but we have plans to make it highly interactive! We don’t want the future to have all the fun! (Eugene)
Piet – example of 2018 Time Capsule


What will the actual time capsules look like?
Eugene show example


When will the Vault be sealed and how do we know it will survive?
Eugene – Nov 2019
Eugene -- Vault 2120 Trust
Does this project have value?
Piet
Dion & Bronwyn


Closing statement
“Taking part in this project means different things to different people. For some it is a way to leave a legacy behind and cheat death a little, for others it is more like time travel – we send stuff to the future, to the 22nd Century. For others it is more existential, a personal thing. They say – this is my story, I was here, my life mattered.”

Expert:
Dr. Eugene Botha Vault 2120
Mr. Dion Chang Flux Trends
Ms. Bronwyn Williams Trends analyst
Dr. Piet Muller Futurologist

Script:


VAULT 2120




LINK
Finding a message in a bottle, is a bit like finding a time capsule, it gives you a glimpse into someone else's life at another time & place. And that's exactly what Vault 2120 hopes to achieve, to send a message to the people of the future.
EUGENE BOTHA
The idea is just to capture something of the time that we live in on a scale that's unprecedented on planet Earth.
V/O
VAULT 2120 is the brainchild of Dr of Theology, Eugene Botha and will consist of 2 separate vaults containing smaller time capsules. The primary vault will be 10 metres by 10 metres by 3 metres high.
EUGENE BOTHA
It's a sturdy concrete thing that will be sealed with a lid properly. And buried three metres underground.
V/O
A wide range of scientific, technological and artistic artefacts will be curated and placed in the primary vault. Including players and power sources for the various technologies. In addition, about 4,000 individual time capsules, filled by Corporates, schools, clubs and families will be included in the vault, giving ordinary South Africans the opportunity to preserve their memories.
EUGENE BOTHA
Most other time capsules in the world were created by organisations and only the organisation and their staff contributed. Our Time Capsule project is open to the whole country.
LINK
Just over 100 years ago Nelson Mandela was born. It was a very different world back then... not many cars on the road, who'd heard of a cell phone, a laptop, a smartwatch? So can you imagine just how much the world will change over the next century?
PIET MULLER
In about 12 years' time they estimate computers will have the same level of intelligence that human beings have. And even exceed human intelligence.
V/O
Philosopher and Futurist, Dr Piet Muller says that advancement over the next century will be equivalent to 1000 times that of the 20th century.
PIET MULLER
By the time that the vault is opened it could be natural to fall in love with a computer, to marry a computer because computers could have emotions like human beings. They could be soft, they could feel like human beings.
V/O
Now is the time to embark on a project like this, says trends analyst Dion Chang, because we're at the so-called point of no return.
DION CHANG
What is really interesting is how all of the “imagined technologies” - driverless cars, flying taxi's, all of those things, are really at that tipping point, so what we store in 2019 and then a hundred years from now is going to be a rather stark contrast, I think.
V/O
There are many different opinions on whether our future will be Utopian or Dystopian, and it is hard to imagine what our world will look like in 100 years from now...
DION CHANG
I actually really can't imagine it. You would take from your move archives there. So, if I'm looking at flying taxis you will sort of see a air grid of that from The 5th Element. That kind of stuff.
BRONWYN WILLIAMS
For me I see the future as being fractal. And the reason for that is because of all these different technologies that are going on at the moment.
V/O
We're already altering embryos and pretty soon we'll be genetically engineering future generations, says future analyst, Bronwyn Williams.
BRONWYN WILLIAMS
Some countries will permit this, other countries will deny this. But that already is a split in humanity. Naturally selected humans vs intelligently designed humans. The you layer on what's going on with automation and disruption in that perspective and how so many current human jobs fall by the wayside as robotics takes over. And when you start layering all these different splits on top of each other we don't have one future ahead of us, we have quite a few.
V/O
The secondary Vault will be placed on top of or near the main vault, and every year an additional smaller annual time capsule will be deposited here.
EUGENE BOTHA
With 15 objects that are iconic of that particular year. And we're going to start with 2018.


V/O
Dr Muller will also assist in compiling the 2018 Time Capsule.
DR PIET MULLER
I think the history of this year has been tremendous. It was the Zumas here in South Africa, the Trump year in America, the year that Merkel in Germany threw in the towel. The Brexit year, the year of the caravans from South America to North America, the year of the continued invasion of North Africa into Europe. Those things would be unknown in a hundred years' time.
V/O
When you buy a time capsule, you're given a certificate which your descendants can then use to claim their treasure. A Trust will be created to look after and maintain the Vault, and to oversee the eventual opening in 2120.
DEREK
Eugene, these may look like boxes but they're actually time capsules?
EUGENE BOTHA
They're time capsules. They're specially manufactured for the project and they contain a standard-size box that people can fill with their precious things and it fits snugly into the time capsule.
DEREK
Now these boxes, well, time capsules have been specially made?
EUGENE BOTHA
They are specially being made here in South Africa and they're tough.
V/O
The time capsules are made from poly-ethylene with an aluminium coating and will withstand the century underground. … But if so much of our information is already stored digitally, one wonders if a vault is really needed.
PIET MULLER
Think of that stiffy that no computer can read anymore. You had the CD which is on its way out. You have the computer stick which everybody loses. You know so much information got lost.


V/O
The Main Vault will be sealed in November 2019 at a location to be announced in the new year, and the plan is to keep the project alive and interactive for the next 101 years. Visitors to the site will have the opportunity to deposit hand-written letters or DNA swabs.
EUGENE BOTHA
So after a hundred years we'll have a whole bunch of letters from people throughout the course of the century and we'll have DNA collected from people throughout the course of the century. It would be a marvellous research project.
BRONWYN WILLIAMS
For future historians it would be like tapping into a goldmine. Because you've got literally everything you want to know about a particular civilisation at a particular point in time, all in one place, curated and nicely labelled so they will be able to make sense of how it all fits together.
LINK
If given the opportunity to participate what would you include in the vault? Now by popular request of family and friends I'm depositing this guitar. I'm not sure if anybody would be able to play it in 100 years, so maybe that wouldn't have changed...
CELEBS





PROMO 10”
In an effort to preserve the a slice of our civilisation, VAULT 2120 will be sealed next year, filled with treasures for the people of the next century.


PROMO 15”
VAULT 2120 is an ambitious project to preserve a slice of today for the people of the future.

UPSOUND EUGENE:
The idea is just to capture something of the time that we live in on a scale that's unprecedented on planet Earth.


PROMO 15”
In 2019 a Vault with more than 4,000 time capsules will be sealed, only to be opened in 100 years' time.

BRONWYN WILLIAMS
For future historians it would be like tapping into a goldmine. Because you've got literally everything you want to know about a particular civilisation at a particular point in time,



PROMO 30”
If given the opportunity, what would you put in a Time Capsule to be opened in 100 years' time?

CELEB
I think it would be great to preserve seeds, our plants, the laughter of babies because I'm not sure the world as we know it will still exists in a hundred years.


Vault 2120 will give ordinary South Africans the chance to leave a legacy for the 22nd century.

UPSOUND EUGENE:
The idea is just to capture something of the time that we live in on a scale that's unprecedented on planet Earth.

metadata.Unique Selling Point: Vault 2120 South Africa is an international social/historical/scientific experiment to create a secure, airtight and watertight underground vault in South Africa where individuals, companies and institutions will be able to securely deposit artefacts, documents, art works, information, music, technologies, personal/family items and the like in individual containers also known as time capsules. Carte Blanche will have an exclusive look at how the vault will be built, what will be put inside and how this bit of history will be safe-guarded for generations to come.
metadata.Summary: The world is set to change dramatically over the next 100 years. Futurists predict that our world will be unrecognisable by the year 2100. With that in mind Eugene Botha has set out to create the Vault 2120 project. The Vault will be built and sealed in 2019 -- a airtight, watertight concrete vault will be buried underground at a location in Maropeng - the cradle of humankind. Eugene has a representation of what the vault will look like. It will consist of two chambers. One chamber will be the actual vault with "treasures" from our world today -- including never-seen-before works of art and literature, scientific and historic contributions, as well as contributions from individuals and societies. The other chamber will house a yearly time capsule added to the cache. The time capsule will contain some artefacts from the specific year. Together with Eugene and Piet Muller, the presenter will be involved in packing/preparing the time capsule for 2018. So in effect every year something will be added to the vault. A Trust has been established to oversee the process until 2120 when the Vault will be opened.
metadata.Further information: Dion & Bronwyn are trends analysts who can speak to the radical changes awaiting us in the future. Can deliver comment on the Vault and why it is a good idea. Dr Piet Muller is a philosopher and in favour of the idead of a Vault. He is also convinced that the world as we know it is about to change radically. He is one of the people overseeing the 2018 time capsule and will speak to the value of the 15 items added to this year's time capsule. Preliminary Structure of the Story: Opening statement “We are doing something that has never been done before on this scale in the history of the world, and it is called the Vault 2120 Time Capsule Initiative.” LINK at Maropeng: This is the cradle of humankind, but this spot will have a greater significance for generations to come... What exactly is Vault 2120? (Eugene, show model and animation) Social, cultural, scientific and historical experiment, Vault underground, Individual time capsules for 101 years, Sealed in 2019 Why are you doing this? (Eugene) Reason 1: “I have always been fascinated by Time Capsules. They are Time capsules are mesmerizing, mysterious, enigmatic, even romantic. They tell stories of another time, they hold secrets, they bring the past to life.” Reason 2: The world as we know it, is set to change fundamentally and rapidly How will the world change? (Chang, Williams & Muller) Examples Dion Chang & Bronwyn Williams of new and exponential technologies Examples by Piet Muller of the Future But there are other more negative possibilities: Climate change Sun storm -- something like the Carrington event Meteorite hitting earth What will you put inside the Vault and Time Capsules? General overview of participants and special time capsules (Eugene) Specific Time Capsules (Dion & Bronwyn on Capsule with predictions) But is a vault underground not boring? It is, but we have plans to make it highly interactive! We don’t want the future to have all the fun! (Eugene) Piet – example of 2018 Time Capsule What will the actual time capsules look like? Eugene show example When will the Vault be sealed and how do we know it will survive? Eugene – Nov 2019 Eugene -- Vault 2120 Trust Does this project have value? Piet Dion & Bronwyn Closing statement “Taking part in this project means different things to different people. For some it is a way to leave a legacy behind and cheat death a little, for others it is more like time travel – we send stuff to the future, to the 22nd Century. For others it is more existential, a personal thing. They say – this is my story, I was here, my life mattered.”
